findings.title: Q gate evidence self-contradiction: committed dry-run evidence carries numeric per-fold PnL outcomes for all 6 arms
findings.detail: research/control/v15_run/q_six_arm_sanitized_dry_run.json (committed at 824190c and pinned by code_freeze_v15.json q_evidence) contains, for each of the 6 arms, fold_signs.fold_net_sums = {F0,F1,F2} numeric net PnL sums at 12-decimal precision (e.g. elite anchor F0 -0.394536218279, F1 +0.011217330564, F2 -0.244372645064) and fold_positive booleans derived from them (notably CTL-ELITELEVEL positive 3/3 folds - a preregistered falsification-relevant signal). The same artifact's mode field attests 'outcome values never extracted into committed evidence (only counts/booleans/digests)' and the code-freeze/commit message claims 'outcomes never extracted into evidence'. These are real-data values (fold day counts 121/120/122 match the frozen fold calendar in a9f), not synthetic: with scored=false the computation is identical and the scored flag is recorded verbatim. Effect: Stage-A-relevant outcomes are pre-visible to auditor and owner BEFORE the two-key GO, defeating the sanitization property the Q gate attests and creating exactly the rescue-lever surface p3_freeze forbids ('changes after scored PnL is visible are rescue and forbidden'). Budget remains 0/6 and no ledger exists, so this is not a scored-publication breach; it is a false attestation inside a gate artifact plus pre-GO outcome exposure.
findings.evidence: research/control/v15_run/q_six_arm_sanitized_dry_run.json arms.*.fold_signs.fold_net_sums (6 blocks); mode field in same file; commit 824190c message; verified present at 824190c via git show (6 occurrences of fold_net_sums)
findings.required_remediation: owner-adjudicated: rewrite/replace the Q evidence artifact without fold_net_sums/fold_positive (counts/booleans/digests only, per its own mode claim), re-record Q PASS on the sanitized artifact, and record an incident note; the fold-sign facts may be presented to the owner only at the two-key stop as explicitly-labeled dry-run diagnostics, not as 'no outcomes committed'
